title: Batch norm and inverted dropout, train and eval modes
hints: Training: mu = x.mean(0), var = x.var(0) (biased, divide by N), x_hat = (x - mu) / sqrt(var + eps), out = gamma * x_hat + beta. Eval: the same formula with running_mean and running_var in place of the batch statistics.

Running stats are an exponential moving average, PyTorch convention: running = (1 - momentum) * running + momentum * batch_stat, and the batch variance fed into it is the unbiased one (multiply the biased variance by N / (N - 1)). Return new arrays; do not mutate the inputs.
Inverted dropout: mask = rng.random(x.shape) >= p, out = x * mask / (1 - p) in training so E[out] = x; in eval return x unchanged with a mask of ones.
